question: Could you provide the annual percentage shares, rounded to two decimal places, of the top 5 minor crime categories from 2008 in London's total crimes, with each year displayed in one row?
sql:
WITH top5_2008 AS (
  SELECT minor_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  WHERE year = 2008
  GROUP BY minor_category
  ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC
  LIMIT 5
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT year, SUM(value) as total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
),
category_by_year AS (
  SELECT c.year, c.minor_category, SUM(c.value) as cat_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa` c
  JOIN top5_2008 t ON c.minor_category = t.minor_category
  GROUP BY c.year, c.minor_category
)
SELECT 
  y.year,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.minor_category = 'Other Theft' THEN c.cat_crimes END), y.total_crimes) * 100, 2) AS other_theft_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.minor_category = 'Theft From Motor Vehicle' THEN c.cat_crimes END), y.total_crimes) * 100, 2) AS theft_from_motor_vehicle_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.minor_category = 'Possession Of Drugs' THEN c.cat_crimes END), y.total_crimes) * 100, 2) AS possession_of_drugs_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.minor_category = 'Burglary in a Dwelling' THEN c.cat_crimes END), y.total_crimes) * 100, 2) AS burglary_in_dwelling_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.minor_category = 'Assault with Injury' THEN c.cat_crimes END), y.total_crimes) * 100, 2) AS assault_with_injury_pct
FROM year_totals y
LEFT JOIN category_by_year c ON y.year = c.year
GROUP BY y.year, y.total_crimes
ORDER BY y.year
